title: CASREP Command — synthetic local review workflow
description: Dependency-free local INITIAL-report demonstration. Persona selection and CO release are simulations; no messaging, identity or synchronization service is connected.

components.label: Draft and routing workspace
components.description: Labeled synthetic report editor, persona switcher, current holder, return/revise and explicit save/discard.

components.label: Revision-bound review engine
components.description: Inline classic-JS core: allowed transitions, ordered reviewers, approval invalidation, immutable released snapshot and synthetic lifecycle relationships.

components.label: Amendment and conflict review
components.description: Preserve immutable revision DAG; compare both simulated competing amendments and create explicit resolution with all heads as parents.

components.label: Local persistence and audit
components.description: Versioned localStorage envelope; persist before saved confirmation; recover drafts, history, comments and revision-bound decisions on reload.

components.label: Simulated CO release and export
components.description: Local text download only, explicitly not an official Navy message; includes exact approved content and readable lineage/audit.

components.label: Application core verification
components.description: Node built-in tests execute the actual marked inline core extracted from index.html; no independent duplicate engine.
